_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/choices/test_choose_card_type.py. t_cct_recall chooses a CARD type and returns every card of it from your graveyard -- Creeping Renaissance over the nine types of 205.2a, so an instant and a sorcery can be the answer. t_cct_herald is Serra's Emissary's choice line on a vanilla creature: as it enters, choose a card type, stored on the permanent. The rest are graveyard fodder: an instant, a sorcery and a creature.

cards.name: Test Card Type Recall
cards.oracle_text: Choose a card type. Return all cards of the chosen type from your graveyard to your hand.
